In options and volatility trading, multi-agent architectures that separate the decision to take risk from the policy used to hedge it have been shown to improve risk-adjusted performance relative to traditional or single-agent baselines [Bańka and Chudziak, 2025, Chen et al., 2025]. At the same time, explainable AI (XAI) techniques and sentimentaware tail risk models demonstrate that interpretable drivers of risk can be extracted and communicated to portfolio managers and risk committees [Exp, 2023, Klinkert, 2024].
